title: koeleria longiglumis
intro: Koeleria longiglumis, commonly known as the blue grass or June grass, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria longiglumis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and aid in the treatment of digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
